**CloudCore Help Bot** — Your guide to using the interview and booking system. No appointment needed — just open the chat and ask.

**Ask me about:**

- How to book an interview with CloudCore staff
- How to use the chat interface
- Understanding the access tiers (public, consultant, auditor)
- Troubleshooting common issues
- Tips for preparing your interviews

**How to Chat:** Click the "+" icon in the lower right corner of your screen to open the chat interface. Type your question into the text box and press Enter to send.

*Note: The Help Bot can assist with platform navigation only. For questions about CloudCore operations, book an interview with the relevant staff member.*
